crossRefs.note: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol…
Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying…
He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
translations.bsb: They sent spies to Bethel (formerly known as Luz),
translations.kjv: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
translations.asv: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Beth-el. (Now the name of the city beforetime was Luz.)
